candidate_objective_classes.purpose: rank DTM-positive or conversion-positive continuation moves above winning-nonoptimal hard negatives within the same state family
penalize compounding drift across a bounded plan window, not just first-move mismatch
explicitly contrast positive moves with safe-looking but slow/stagnating moves
label when a sequence policy should hand off to validated providers rather than continue owning

design_principles: optimize multi-step sequence behavior rather than one-ply local score only
train against state-local hard negatives that share broad visible terms
separate move ranking from ownership/routing decisions
preserve frozen Stage 5/6 providers and M1-M4 semantics
require default-off sandbox plus guardrails before any future causal use
design_scope: future ranked sequence-policy / model-expression redesign only
future_review_questions: Can a state-local contrastive objective improve top-1 without increasing hard-negative ranking?
Does sequence-level supervision reduce closed-loop drift on held-out families?
Which data should be collected outside Stage 7 so the model is not overfit to the post-box residual set?
What default-off sandbox and guardrails would be required before any future causal evaluation?
